data.name: Greater Link
data.description: The link between you and your eidolon is stronger than most. Your eidolon's current and maximum hit point totals are not reduced by 50%% until you are separated by 110 feet or more. Your eidolon's current and maximum hit point totals are not reduced by 75%% until you are separated by 1,100 feet or more. All other aspects of your life link class feature are unaffected.
